name: Character AI
freeTier: Free unlimited text chat with ads and some limits; huge character library.
boyfriendMode: Yes. Many user-made male/romance characters, but romantic content is filtered.

notes: minAge 13 for account (18 for open-ended chat). Group chat ('rooms') and voice features from general knowledge, not re-verified. Launch year (public beta Sept 2022) from general knowledge.
